idea-plugin.name: SVG Asset Compliance Lint
idea-plugin.description:
14 rules over the SVG files your design tool exported, before they become a legal object

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → SVG Asset Compliance Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/svg-asset-compliance-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/svg-asset-compliance-lint

action.text: SVG Asset Compliance Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run SVG Asset Compliance Lint on the file in the editor
